title: Needs work
text:
I’m a paid subscriber and I like the app overall, but it needs a few things fixed, which I will outline below.

1. The rest timer sits on top of the keypad, meaning you can’t write out the next sets reps and weight amount unless you skip the timer. It would be much better if the timer was in another spot so it doesn’t hide the keypad.

2. Some more clarification on dumbbell-based workouts. It would be great to know if the app wants me to log the total weight of the dumbbells or if it wants me to enter the weight of one dumbbell.

3. The live activity widget showcases the weight you’re doing in KG even if the app settings are set to use LB. This is really just a minor visual bug that could be tweaked easily. 

4. This is more of a want than a need, but it would be awesome to see some features geared to PPL programs, so people like myself who may not entirely know what the program is *all* about can fill in the blanks with the app.

Overall, really good app and I don’t have much other complaints about it!

title: Lots of useful features, but the logic for adapting the app is confusing
text: This is a good and convenient app for those who work out at the gym and want to stick to their workouts. However, I don't really like the logic of this app. For example, I usually follow my usual workouts, so I already have a plan in my head. But I downloaded this app to add some variety to my workouts and try new exercises, so I wanted the app to create a workout for me. The problem is, I do different workouts throughout the week for a specific area (legs, arms, back), and I wanted the app to create that workout for me, but each time it gives me a "quick workout" or a "full-body workout" for different areas and muscle groups. For some reason, workouts I've done in my calendar are constantly disappearing. For example, on Wednesday, I did a back workout, and the entire workout was recorded, and I finished and saved it, but for some reason, that workout then disappeared. Basically, all the workouts I recorded and saved so I could easily use a template later weren't saved, and I have to recreate the entire workout every time (but I like that my weights are still saved). I tried to figure it all out, but it's a bit difficult to do in this app because when you logically think "this button" should be responsible for "that," and this "that" is actually completely different, you get confused about what's where, which makes it hard to "learn" what's where in the app.
